output.reason: 所提供的证据充分支持该问题中可用于识别的渠道。证据显示：Twitter 和 Reddit 上患有 BD 的用户通过自我报告的诊断陈述被自动识别，例如“I was diagnosed with BD-I last week”，并扩展了 BIBREF47 中的诊断模式和术语（Data 部分，s1-p1）。相关博客被人工识别，且会联系其作者以获得知情同意（Data 部分，s1-p1）。一份由具有 BD 诊断的个体组成的顾问委员会被纳入项目，该提案已向其提交并获正面反馈，该委员会将在多个阶段接受咨询（Ethical considerations 部分，s3-p6）。这些内容均已由所提供证据直接覆盖，因此问题可以完整回答，来源引用见上。

claims.text: Twitter and Reddit users with a BD diagnosis are to be identified automatically via self-reported diagnosis statements, such as “I was diagnosed with BD-I last week”, extending on previously provided BD diagnosis patterns and terms.
For Twitter and Reddit users, implicit consent is assumed to use their public tweets and posts.
Relevant blogs are to be manually identified, and their authors contacted to obtain informed consent for using their texts.

The proposal has been presented to an advisory board of individuals with a BD diagnosis and was received positively; the board will be consulted at several stages of the project to inform research design, analysis, and publication of results.

Data relevant to BD in general and to personal recovery in BD are planned to be collected from three sources: Twitter, Reddit (focusing on mental health-related content unlike previous work), and blogs authored by affected individuals.
The evidence does not state how the accuracy or validity of the self-reported BD diagnosis identification is verified, nor does it report any classification performance metrics.
The evidence does not provide the number of Twitter, Reddit, or blog participants identified, nor details on how many blogs were selected.
The evidence does not describe how advisory board members were recruited or selected, beyond noting the board consists of individuals with a BD diagnosis.
